{{Quote|Who'd want to go to Geonosis? It's nothing but a bug's nest!|Chal Tozr|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
'''Geonosis''', called '''Geonosia''' by some natives, was a [[Planetary ring/Legends|ringed]], rocky [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], it was known for its droid factories and violent [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games. Geonosis was a major stronghold of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], due to it hosting major [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundries. It was the site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the opening conflict of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Geology and geography==
{{Quote|This place is rotten from the inside out.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="LOT" />}}
[[File:Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|170px|The desolate surface of Geonosis.]]
Geonosis had a large diameter but light gravity and dense atmosphere. With a weak magnetic field, harsh solar radiation storms and massive sandstorms were common, and on occasion, mass extinctions occurred. The most persistent surface organisms were humble red rock algae while the semi-insectoid [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] were driven underground. The planet consisted of a diminutive molten core with a rocky mantle forming a rocky, desert world subject to flash floods that carved great highland canyons. Water made up 5% of the surface.

During the time of the Geonosian rule, much of the planet's architecture was similar in appearance to termite mounds, consisting of domes and buildings built into caverns and rock [[Geonosian spire|spires]]. Therefore, one could easily mistake Geonosian buildings for natural formations and the planet to be uninhabited, a great asset during war.

==History==
===Early history===
In the distant past, Geonosis's largest moon was hit by a rogue comet, sending out a massive debris field, which hammered the surface into ruin before settling into a ring of orbiting rock. This event killed off more than 99% of Geonosis's native species. Over millions of years, the few creatures who survived the devastation slowly reclaimed the planet. Random meteor impacts constantly weeded out the weaker species, leaving only the truly cunning, hardy, and ruthless species alive. The [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], the dominant life form on the planet, constituted all three. Ruled in various independent hives, great wars would periodically break out on the planet's surface.

Geonosis was first explored by [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] when [[Miner/Legends|miners]] settled nearby [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The technically-minded Geonosians were fascinated by the outsiders' technology and proved adept at finding new efficiencies in devices' function and production. This period saw the foundation of the first [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid foundries]], and the Geonosians developed [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] in their own image.<ref name="TEA" />

===Great Galactic War===
{{Quote|In the arenas of Geonosis a young gladiator had risen to prominence, calling himself the new Mandalore, a title unclaimed for centuries, a title reserved for the greatest warrior in the galaxy, a warrior worthy to lead the Mandalorians.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref>}}
During the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], Geonosis was famous for the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial games]] held on the planet. Many of the combatants were [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], among them a [[Mandalore the Lesser|young fighter]]. He rose to fame, eventually declaring himself the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]. He allied the Mandalorians with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], striking against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Years later, after his eventual death at the hands of [[Mandalore the Vindicated|another Mandalorian]], it was revealed that [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] had been infiltrating the gladiatorial arenas around the galaxy as sponsors, managers, and gladiators. They had chosen the young Mandalorian as their champion, rigging his fights, using tactics such as drugging the opponent.

In [[3645 BBY]], the Republic evaluated the planet as a possible defense stronghold. A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warship crash-landed there, and [[Rojo Trace]] was sent by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to investigate.<ref name="RHEAW">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>

===Recessional===
Contacts between the Republic and the Arkanis sector proved fleeting, however, and the Geonosians' advances were soon copied by corporations closer to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Additionally, contact with outsiders caused a deep rift among the hives that soon erupted into yet more savage warfare. Geonosis was abandoned by the greater galaxy and it was not until the Republic's final centuries that [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] reestablished contact once more. The hives eventually struck a distribution deal with the [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] that returned their labor droids to the galactic market.<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars===
====Prelude to war====
{{Quote|More happening on Geonosis, I feel, than has been revealed.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="SWE2" />}}
In the final decades of the Galactic Republic, Geonosis came to the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who was impressed by the Geonosians' engineering skills. He ensured the rise of the [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] to the position of [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]], and then used the planet's connections to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] through Baktoid to create an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TEA" />

To hide the military buildup, several hives left Geonosis and established colonies to act as factory worlds across the galaxy, including [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], [[Zaadja/Legends|Zaadja]] and [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]]. 

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], under the leadership of [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], Geonosis joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which used the planet's [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|factories]] to build its [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]]. This resulted in the formation of the [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|Geonosian Industries]].

Two years later, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Poggle scheduled a private meeting of the Confederacy leaders on Geonosis. It was expected that during this meeting the organizations that formed the backbone of the Confederacy would put their resources at the disposal of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the Head of State of the Confederacy.

====First battle of the Clone Wars====
{{Quote|Frankly I'm still amazed we ever made it through the first hour, never mind the first day.|Unnamed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] clone trooper|<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
Unbeknownst to the Confederacy, their plans of waging war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were overheard by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had followed [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] employed by Dooku, to Geonosis. Kenobi managed to transmit his discoveries to his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was at that time located on Tatooine, before being caught by the Separatists. After retransmitting the information to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Skywalker and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the Senator of Naboo, decided to rescue Kenobi, but ended up imprisoned themselves.<ref name="SWE2" />

Eventually, Kenobi, Skywalker and Amidala were taken to the [[Petranaki arena]] and were faced against an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], a [[Reek/Legends|reek]], and a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] respectively, but managed to free themselves. The Separatists, in turn, introduced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to the arena, triggering the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as Jedi reinforcements, led by Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], revealed themselves among the public and entered the arena to confront the droids. After a long battle between the droids and the Jedi, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with the newly-formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic army]] and rescued the defeated Jedi forces.<ref name="SWE2" /> Following the Confederacy's subsequent defeat on the planet, Geonosis was occupied by the Republic, and kept under strong control.

Jedi Knight [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was [[Mission to Geonosis (Barriss Offee)|working]] on Geonosis during the Clone Wars.<ref name="CoD Decoded">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness|d=y}}</ref>

====Second Republic assault====
[[File:2nd_Battle_of_Geonosis_2.png|thumb|left|250px|The second Battle of Geonosis]]
{{Quote|Good thing those bugs can't aim.|Unknown [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], just before getting shot down along with his [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|transport]]|<ref name="Landing" />}}
Some time later, plans for a new droid foundry funded by Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] and the Banking Clan were uncovered by Senator Amidala,<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> leading up to another [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on the planet. Jedi Masters [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker led an assault on Geonosis to destroy Poggle the Lesser's new droid foundry. However, the factory turned out to be very heavily guarded, and the assault met with heavy losses of men and material.The Geonosians deployed several squadrons of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Nantex-class territorial defense starfighters]] that decimated the landing force, even before landing. Shot down and cut off from each other, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Mundi were forced to fight their way to their first prime objective: an assault staging area.<ref name="Landing" />

Skywalker and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] ended up going through a canyon where a fortress had been erected, destroying it in the process. They discovered Master Mundi, who had made his way through a tunnel that ended with him losing many men. Kenobi was no better off. His perimeter was being actively destroyed by the Geonosian forces and AAT tanks. Skywalker called in reinforcements and destroyed the Geonosian forces. From there Skywalker and his Padawan destroyed the shield generator with one swift stroke.<ref name="Landing" />

Luminara Unduli and Barriss Offee showed up to help take the factory down. They lead a full frontal assault while the Padawans found their way through the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] under the factory where Poggle and a new "[[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]]" found them and went to take their bombs that they had set on the Main Reactor. Outside, the tactical droid had sent out a dozen tanks to rupture them. They were all destroyed by a sense of ingenuity by the Jedi Masters. The Padawans took the Reactor out with a Super Tank missile and almost sacrificed themselves to do it. They were rescued in the end by their masters.<ref name="WF">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

Towards the later stages of the war, construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] began by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] under orders of [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], secret leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]].<ref name="RotS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

===Post-Clone Wars===
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|ended]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Geonosis began to be under Imperial control in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The Empire took possession of the planet's vast manufacturing facilities. <ref name="EAW" /><ref>[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook'']]</ref> 

Geonosian [[Gizor Dellso]] and several other Geonosians formed a Separatist holdout during the aftermath of the Mission to Mustafar, but the organization was dissolved during the [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Battle of Mustafar]].<ref name="BFII" /> Geonosian scientists and slaves also played a role in the construction of the Death Star, and the Death Star's test bed was once moved temporarily to Geonosis. During the Galactic Civil War, Geonosian scientists set up a [[Geonosian Bio-Lab|bio-lab]] on Yavin 4.

The Geonosians were primarily used for slave labor by the Empire.<ref name="EAW" /> However, in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a Geonosian revolt was instigated by Rebel forces, who had built a secret base on Geonosis. Darth Vader, leading an invasion force, was sent to crush the revolt in what became the Subjugation of Geonosis. Although the Geonosians and the Rebels, fighting side by side, put up a good deal of resistance, the Imperials emerged victorious in the end, destroying all present [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives, [[Subjugation of Geonosis|subjugating]] the revolting Geonosians and leaving destroyed their homes.

The Alliance would later sent a [[Geonosis strike team (Rebel)|strike team]] to [[Infiltration of Geonosis Imperial base|Infiltrate]] an [[Geonosis Imperial base|imperial base]] on the planet. But they were discovered and imprisoned. In response the Rebel Alliance sent another team to [[Mission to Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|rescue]] them under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. The mission was a success thanks to leadership of General Kota, [[X2]] and members of the [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|vanguard division]].<ref name="BF:ESN">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version</ref> 

At some point after Geonosis was made a testing center for the Death Star, the ''StarSpeeder 1000'' transport, SF 1401, exited hyperspace to deliver a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel agent]] to the Rebel Alliance, near Geonosis. However, the Imperials and Boba Fett [[Skirmish at Geonosis|ambushed]] them, which eventually cumulated in a dogfight in the interior of the Death Star before escaping to the ''Home One''.<ref name="ST:TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
 [[File:Battle_Over_Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The battle over Geonosis during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], while chasing an Imperial carrier that had interfered with the Rebel Alliance's raid on the Empire's operations on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] visited Geonosis and found several completely operational [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] left over from the war, as well as a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi starfighter]], which he used to escape the planet. Soon after, the droid operations were [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|put down]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which ultimately brought an official end to the Geonosian [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. During that battle, three [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carriers]] ended up being destroyed. [[Sarkli]] took cover from the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in a crashed, but working, [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]].<ref name="RSIII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> 

At some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Empire had retreated its fleet from the entire Arkanis sector, bringing a definitive end to decades of [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] and occupation of Geonosis.<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>

At some point between the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] and the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]], an Alliance envoy named Mu Nanb would go on to contact [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]] of the [[Gogum Hive]] to broker a deal about weapons.

The planet was spared by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]].

Around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] returned to Geonosis to exhume his father's remains and bury them next to his daughter, [[Ailyn Vel]], on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="BL">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Geonosis_TEA.jpg|thumb|200px|Geonosis in the form of a globe]]
The concept of a rock planet in the Star Wars saga could be traced back to early story ideas for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In a story conference, George Lucas had named the concept planet "[[Ttaz]]." He described it as a "Rock planet with cavemen".<ref name="Galaxy Building">{{SW|url=news/galaxy-building-from-alderaan-to-utapau|text=Galaxy Building, from Alderaan to Utapau|int=Galaxy Building, from Alderaan to Utapau|nolive=1}}</ref>

Geonosis made its first appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and related material. [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' contains a story arc about the Republic recapture of Geonosis.

Geonosis is the only planet featured in the ''Star Wars'' films to have a natural ring system. In the novel [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space|''Wild Space'']], it is mentioned that Geonosis was an arid planet whose "moist green beauty [was] long burned away", possibly meaning that sometime in its history Geonosis was a more habitable planet.

The Geonosian rings serve as a location for multiple Versus Mode matches in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.
